original_batch.first_failure: CUDA out of memory in torch.nn.functional.normalize; then cascading CUDA failures
original_batch.note: Total device memory, not per-process; WDDM per-process allocation unavailable.

conclusion: The first failing pure-PyTorch node passes unchanged on both baseline and fixed revision in fresh idle-GPU processes, with equal allocator peak and zero allocator OOMs. The original batch had resource pressure and a poisoned CUDA context; it is retained as failed, not counted as complete. These controls do not alone attribute every later failure; separate full recovery remains required.
